notes.title: 1.8.4 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed a bug that would make you to re-enter the control settings screen right after applying a change.

notes.title: 1.8.3 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the online scoreboard was not working.

notes.title: 1.8.1 & 1.8.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]1.8.1[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where you could not move with the D-pad when using a controller.

[*] Reduced the dead zone of the analog stick.[/list]

[h2]1.8.2[/h2]
[list][*] You can now select whether to use the analog input of the Xinput controller.

[*] Elfame's movement speed has been increased.

[*] Increased the volume of the background music.[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Entire background music has been replaced.

[*] DirectInput joysticks are now supported.

[*] Analog inputs are applied to the movement and thrust of the aircraft.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.9 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the UI color did not appear properly when it was set to the planet color.

notes.title: 1.7.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Increased the perspective of the background and increased the number of stars in it.

[*] Corrected the color of the background terrain.

[*] Corrected typo.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.7 Patch Note
notes.content: Visual effects that mimic CRT screens have been added to the game. This can be turned on or off in the options.

notes.title: 1.7.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The terrain color was slightly darkened.

[*] The scanner now displays the color of the terrain.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when returning from fullscreen to windowed mode.

[*] Now the version number is displayed on the title screen.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.4 Patch Note
notes.content: Adjusted the balance of the game.

notes.title: 1.7.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] A language change option has been added to the game.

[*] Adjusted the volume of some sound effects.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.2 Patch Note
notes.content: Adjusted the game's overall difficulty to match the player's movement speed.

notes.title: 1.7.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The acceleration of Pentamsa and Elfame has been slightly reduced.

[*] Fixed bugs related to Smart-torpedo.

[*] The launch rate of Smart-torpedo has been reduced.

[*] Hunters and Baiters that appear over time will now spawn alternately.[/list]

notes.title: 1.7.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The position of the Pod/Hive intercept timer has been moved to the right side of the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36481845/b5ee09995369ae019c9aa59f2285f9a2214dcbed.png[/img]


[*] Fixed a bug where Invaders' attack speed slowed down or increased when the number of Humanoids was one.

[*] Invaders now teleport if the Humanoid dies while the Invaders grab the humanoid and ascend.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Reduced the speed of enemy Micron's horizontal movement and increased the speed of vertical movement.

[*] Adjusted the difficulty of Classic Mode.

[*] Minor bug fixes.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Added a controller vibration feature.

[*] Increased the difficulty of Classic Mode.

[*] Increased the game's performance by re-compiling it.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.6 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where controller input settings apply incorrectly.

notes.title: 1.6.0 & 1.6.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] When playing the Custom mode, you can now adjust your starting life count.

[*] Buffed Smart-torpedo. Now fired Smart-torpedo will attack both upper and lower areas while flying around.

[*] Fixed some issues related to Smart-torpedo.[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an error that occurs when using time stop.

[*] When using Smart Bomb, sound effect of dying enemies will now no longer be played at once.

[*] Lowered the attacking speed of Baiters and Jumpers.

[*] Increased the delay of spawning Baiters and Hunters at boss wave.

[*] Decreased the amount of enemies at Space Wave and Planet Bombard Raid.

[*] Changed the sound effect of landing humanoid, which will be more noticeable.

[*] Added the script that checks the connection with the server. If you're not connected, the game will be changed to offline mode.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.8 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where controller input settings didn't work properly.

notes.title: 1.4.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] 2 new background music were added.
[*] Removed debug mode.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Now you'll get bonus points by making enemy units fall to death.
[*] Enemy Planters' movement speed was reduced slightly.
[*] Attack speed of enemy Baiters has been slightly reduced.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Adjusted some grammatical errors.
[*] Fixed a bug where Hyperspace Enter event would occur, when the game was over while clearing the 4th wave.
[*] Now you can remap your controller inputs in settings.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The height of the mountains in the background has been increased.
[*] Fixed an issue where ranks recorded in Steam Leaderboard were not displayed in order.[/list]
